content: Virat Kohli is an Indian cricketer born on 5 November 1988 in Delhi. A right-handed top-order batter, he represented India at the Under-19 level before making his senior international debut in 2008.
Virat Kohli captained India across formats from 2013 to 2022. He is known for run chases, high fitness standards, and a prolific record in international limited-overs cricket and Test cricket.
Rohit Sharma is an Indian cricketer born on 30 April 1987 in Nagpur, Maharashtra. He is a right-handed opening batter who made his international debut for India in 2007.

Rohit Sharma is noted for elegant timing and long innings in limited-overs cricket. He is the only batter to score three double centuries in men's One Day Internationals, including 264 against Sri Lanka in 2014, the highest individual ODI score.

Cristiano Ronaldo is a Portuguese footballer born on 5 February 1985 in Funchal, Madeira. A forward, he began his senior career at Sporting CP and later played for Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus, and Al Nassr.

Cristiano Ronaldo has captained Portugal and helped the national team win UEFA Euro 2016 and the 2019 UEFA Nations League. He has won the Ballon d'Or five times and is recognized for his goalscoring, aerial ability, and longevity.

Kylian Mbappe is a French footballer born on 20 December 1998 in Paris. A forward known for pace and direct running, he started his senior club career at Monaco, then played for Paris Saint-Germain before joining Real Madrid in 2024.

Kylian Mbappe was part of France's 2018 FIFA World Cup-winning team and scored in the final. At the 2022 FIFA World Cup, he scored a hat-trick in the final against Argentina and won the tournament's Golden Boot.
